title: JACO ACFQ final LiteRT integration — sixteen isolated model-review assignments
claim: Sixteen distinct LLM review contexts ONLY when the local runner is actually executed; cannot modify source or invoke GitHub from the runner.

missions.assignment: Inspect source pinning, checkout safety and upstream provenance. Identify a reproducible failure or confirm invariants.
missions.required_output: Decision: POSSIBLE/BLOCKED/NEEDS_EVIDENCE. Evidence: exact source location. One minimal, falsifiable experiment or patch suggestion. Risks. Unknowns.
